name: PreciseWikiQA
intro: PreciseWikiQA是HalluLens的动态外在幻觉评测任务：从GoodWiki页面按WikiRank中心性分层，每次生成5,000条无需上下文的精确事实问答，用于区分错误拒答、尝试回答后的幻觉和正确回答。
org: FAIR at Meta, GenAI at Meta, HKUST
build_method: GoodWiki页面池、WikiRank中心性十档分层抽样、两阶段LLM问答生成与质量过滤
metric: 错误拒答率, 尝试回答后的幻觉率, 总体正确回答率
eval_feature: 每次动态重采样5,000题；无上下文推理；先判拒答再判正确、错误或不可验证；论文报告三次试验
scale: 44,754个GoodWiki页面；十档各抽500页，每次动态生成5,000组问答
build_method_en: GoodWiki page pool, ten WikiRank-centrality strata, two-stage LLM question-answer generation, and quality filtering
eval_feature_en: Dynamically resample 5,000 questions per run; answer without context; judge refusal before correctness; report three trials
intro_en: PreciseWikiQA is HalluLens' dynamic extrinsic-hallucination task. It stratifies GoodWiki pages by WikiRank centrality and generates 5,000 context-free factual questions per run to distinguish false refusals, hallucinations among attempted answers, and correct answers.
scale_en: 44,754 GoodWiki pages; 500 pages from each of ten bins produce 5,000 dynamic QA pairs per run
metric_en: False Refusal Rate, Hallucination Rate among attempted answers, Overall Correct-Answer Rate
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已纠正旧的ERNIE归属，按HalluLens论文与官方仓库核对GoodWiki、WikiRank分层、动态生成、拒答判定与三项指标，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。
